_README: Reviewed bindings for the manipulation gate (scripts/check_manipulation.py). Each entry ties registered conditions whose detections are a DERIVED product (a re-score against another reference, an operating point materialised from a stage's verified probabilities, a K-ladder rung, a union of passes) to the SOURCES the product's documented derivation read: verifier_sources (a registered stage's output; the gate maps each to the registered stage whose directory holds it, recorded here as resolves_to) and proposer_sources (pass or pool directories; the gate reads the passes-manifest metas under each, else the metas on disk). The gate consults an entry only where the register's own routes find nothing. Every entry carries its evidence: the deriving script and lines, the commit that added the product, and documents; caveats say what a reviewer must know. An entry whose caveats record that the stage's only surviving meta covers part of its requests (a cleanup, recovery, resumed or final-round leg) carries incomplete_meta: true with a one-line incomplete_meta_reason; the gate then treats the verifier half of every arm that reads that stage as UNVERIFIABLE rather than taking the partial meta as the whole stage (PR #25 review, finding 4; 28 entries flagged 2026-10-07). Built 2026-10-06 (gate-coverage-2026-10-06) from six read-only provenance investigations; each binding was reproduced against the data where the evidence field says so. Do not add an entry without evidence; tests/test_check_manipulation.py (tier 2) checks the file against the register.
